content:
Long before the iPod, Sony Walkman was the go-to choice for people who wanted a soundtrack to their lives. Now the Duo-Man app recreates that experience for those of us who once owned one, and you can even use it with Apple Music……

Before the Walkman, if you wanted to listen to music on the go, your options were extremely limited. Most cassette players of the time were heavy and bulky. When Sony shrank a recorder originally designed for reporters down to the smallest possible cassette player, it instantly became an iconic product.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created this app at a hackathon — and considering many people there had never seen a real Walkman, he even brought an actual one to show them what it looked like.

You open Duo, pick the album you want to “insert” as a cassette, and close it to start playing.

Bhargava said he originally built it just as a demo app for fun, but will now officially release it as a real app. The best comment on the X post is this — an image that only people of a certain generation would understand.

What was the first music player in your life? Share in the comments.
